2124831829459136893.en_summary: Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan is pushing back on tech industry hopes that AI could cure cancer within five to 10 years, per the FT Narasimhan disputed Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei’s prediction that AI could help find a cure for cancer in under a decade. “Cure is a big word,” he told CNBC. He said AI could instead shorten drug development from about 12 years to eight. Other pharma executives are skeptical too. They argue that cancer is thousands of distinct diseases and that AI can speed up early drug discovery but can’t do much to shorten clinical trials.
2124831829459136893.zh_summary: 諾華 CEO Vas Narasimhan 正在反駁科技行業希望 AI 能在 5 到 10 年內治愈癌症的希望，據 FT。Narasimhan 反駁了 Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 的預測，即 AI 可以在不到十年內幫助找到癌症的治愈方法。「治愈是一個大詞，」他告訴 CNBC。他說 AI 可以將藥物開發從約 12 年縮短到 8 年。其他製藥高管也持懷疑態度。他們認為癌症是數千種不同的疾病，AI 可以加快早期藥物發現，但對縮短臨床試驗幫助不大。

2124828928749494641.en_summary: BOFA SEES GLOBAL GROWTH AT 3.4% IN 2027, U.S. 10-YEAR YIELD REACHING 4.75% Bank of America Global Research released its 2027 economic outlook, forecasting resilient global growth but elevated U.S. borrowing costs. 🔸 Global GDP growth: 3.4% 🔸 U.S. GDP growth: 2.3% 🔸 Eurozone GDP growth: 0.8% 🔸 UK GDP growth: 1.5% BofA expects the U.S. 10-year Treasury yield to reach 4.75% by year-end 2027. Meanwhile, the bank forecasts the European Central Bank cutting interest rates by 50 basis points in late 2027. The outlook highlights diverging monetary policy paths between the U.S. and Europe.
2124828928749494641.zh_summary: 美銀看到 2027 年全球增長 3.4%，美國 10 年期收益率達到 4.75% 美國銀行全球研究發布了其 2027 年經濟展望，預測全球增長有彈性，但美國借款成本升高。🔸 全球 GDP 增長：3.4% 🔸 美國 GDP 增長：2.3% 🔸 歐元區 GDP 增長：0.8% 🔸 英國 GDP 增長：1.5% 美銀預期美國 10 年期國債收益率到 2027 年底達到 4.75%。同時，該銀行預測歐洲央行在 2027 年底降息 50 個基點。展望強調了美國和歐洲之間分歧的貨幣政策路徑。
